title: fix(gateway): check session membership for collaboration reads
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Session collaboration entry points need the same current membership decision as history and discovery.

## User Impact

Questions, companion reads, activity/process summaries, reactions, suggestions and typing respect the session read boundary.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use prepared sharing authorization at these callers and preserve independent write-scope limits.

Stack step **6/17**, based on [fix/guest-access-04-live-events-20261026](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/tree/fix%2Fguest-access-04-live-events-20261026). Review and merge in order; each upper PR contains only its own slice against its predecessor.

Previous: [scope live events and Inbox notifications](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184502).

Next: [prepare native workers before the test watchdog](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185981).

Stack order: [complete stack](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184515#stack-order).

## Evidence

[Current-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40508432741) passed at `6509dbfac9585d5bf687a0600cb79149b646c086`. The [ClawSweeper review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184504#issuecomment-6414256522) covers the same head and reports no actionable findings or required rank-up moves.

Slice head: `6509dbfac9585d5bf687a0600cb79149b646c086`, on fixed main `5bf0c41a03f1dba03d625460607ed5b959710458`. The complete 13-file integration matrix passed 46/46 on pinned Bun at `ddc49fd63d3b82e41eb6c74af4ad935a56aebc8f` before this main rebase. Main's canonical fixture repairs are preserved and duplicate prerequisite changes removed. Prefixes are not separately built locally; each requires its own current-head hosted CI and review.

The final authenticated integration covers question get/list/wait/events, companion reads, process summaries, reactions, suggestions and typing. It checks unrelated denial, allowed member behavior, independent scope limits and removal after preparation. Question/approval waiters and mutation stores are real. Companion reads use a real agent/provider transport against a loopback fixture; removal while the response is held prevents publication and retention. Process rows and typing payloads are synthetic inputs to their real owners.

The [stack evidence ledger](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184515#evidence) records runtime results, prior build/upgrade proof and limits. Integration tests are owned by the final activation PR. Current-head CI and review receipts are linked above.

## Change size

Production **+129/-138**; tests **+121/-72**.

Collaboration reads share one authorization path; duplicated per-caller policy is removed.

### Test-line allowance

`config/test-lines-baseline.txt`: **6,283,374 → 6,283,423** (**+49**). Covers question preparation and membership-aware collaboration reads. The ceiling equals this prefix's measured 6,283,423 test lines; no spare allowance is added. This is a bounded baseline exception under the repository testing workflow, not a functional-test waiver. No runtime assertion, SDK budget or required CI check is weakened. Change-size test counts include the baseline metadata edit.

## October 28 landing qualification

This section supersedes the earlier current-head labels above; those receipts remain historical. The collaboration-only commit was restacked onto main base 702c2957fadc79a4c3ba5d046842d918e2909f12, including the separately reproduced and merged fixture repair [#186450](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186450). Final slice head: **d4c06c1505ccbcc1811f36fb990bb6a0d3ad79aa** (tree 178443593b30e01cd8a94146b817d023a6e1dcfb). Range-diff preserves the original production/test patch; only the exact ratchet and required commit credit metadata differ.

- [Exact-head required CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40637261797): **passed**, including openclaw/ci-gate; the [applicable security status](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40638274461) also reports success.
- Final-head scoped suites: **12 files / 171 tests passed**, 188.75 seconds. tsgo:core, scoped typed lint (11 files), formatting (11 files), ratchet and git diff --check passed.
- Independent local Codex autoreview, P0–P2: clean on the committed collaboration range, including a supplemental full-context pass with the canonical sharing/preparation/presentation owners. Patch-identical rebases and unchanged reviewed owner modules were verified; hosted exact-head review is requested after this evidence update.
- The ratchet is exactly **6,296,931 measured test lines, zero slack** (reduced from the current base's 6,300,000 ceiling); this slice adds 49 test lines without deleting tests or assertions to make room.

### Fresh AWS behavior proof

Provider **AWS**, profile **openclaw-check**, machine **c7a.2xlarge**; actual resources **8 vCPUs / 15,613 MiB RAM**. Crabbox doctor passed before allocation. Lease cbx_c83cc41b2dfe; completed run run_eaf90e19a3208193be9598055e6f3818. Supported Node **24.22.1**, pinned pnpm, separate synthetic state and free loopback ports. Both the pinned main base and final head were built with the repository-owned gatewayWatch runtime profile and booted as real Gateways. This is runtime proof, not a UI or declaration-build claim; broad CI is linked above.

Six distinct trusted-proxy principals used authenticated **WebSocket protocol 4**, matching native build IDs and **no operator.admin scope**. The completed comparison recorded **100 base calls / 110 head calls**, including six connection admissions per revision:

| Boundary | Observed result |
| --- | --- |
| Questions, companion reads, activity summary requests, process lists, reaction/suggestion reads, personal involvement | All eight invited-member negative controls deny on base and succeed on head. Question list visibility is also checked. |
| Unrelated principal | Denied at the real collaboration authorization boundaries on both revisions. |
| Member interactions | Question answer/request/cancel, reaction persistence, suggestion persistence, owner assignment and typing succeed on head. The typing recipient uses the real message subscription and observes the event. |
| Independent scopes | A separate actual member with exactly operator.read succeeds at permitted head reads; all five tested mutations fail for the missing write/questions scope. The legacy view control remains a separate nonmember. |
| Live revocation | Public session.members.remove, on the same connected member, blocks the next read and interaction; newly requested questions are hidden and not delivered. |
| Existing view / none policies | Normalized outcomes match exactly between base and head. |
| Real run wait | A real public agent request settles with a credentialless execution error; authorized waiters observe that terminal state. Unrelated and removed invited callers are concealed on head, versus the old base's early disclosure. This is authorization proof, **not successful inference**. |

The earlier event slice already permits authorized question-event delivery on the base; both revisions retain that correct behavior. No generated recap text, external model inference, remote worker/process execution or external channel mirroring is claimed. Fixture corrections were confined to the unpushed proof payload, not production code.

Both task-owned Gateway process groups were confirmed absent. Bounded teardown used SIGKILL after the graceful-stop window (exit 137), so this is not graceful-shutdown proof. Artifacts were collected before lease release and remained readable with the same SHA-256 afterward: b46847623a39797fffd95c20bc3ebcc3c77ca447b4f7a719dc49b4ef78d62f42. Final standalone proof payload SHA-256: 86881a6bde4a9426522a4a279c7da51f16ace83e27ce90504e0182a88fbb55c5.

Independent provider inspection after stop confirmed state=released, hasHost=false, ready=false, cleanupStatus=complete and provisioningResourceMayExist=false; cleanup completed **2026-10-28T05:58:34.890Z**. No lease is retained.

### Proof-only enum enablement (uncommitted and unpushed)

The same local-only activation was applied to both disposable source copies, followed by config:docs:gen and config:schema:gen. The generated counts file remained unchanged. The exact shared diff was:
